en.title: Social Connections (Visible Profiles per Query)
en.description:
You are given an undirected social graph. Each queried user can see all users in their connected component (including themselves); for each query, in the original order, output the size of that connected component.

The input format, examples, and test data were compiled and written by CSWork; see the statement for the original source and the limits added by this site.
en.input: The first line is `N E Q`; then E lines follow, each an undirected edge `u v`; the last line contains Q queried user numbers. The OAMaster examples use 1-based user numbers; this site specifies 1≤N≤200000, 0≤E,Q≤200000 with E+Q≤200000, and all numbers in 1..N. Duplicate edges and self-loops are allowed (neither changes the connected components).
en.output: Output one line with Q integers: for each query in order, the number of vertices in that user's connected component.
en.explanation: Process the input according to the rules above; see the accompanying notes for the approach, proof of correctness, and complexity.
hints: Process all edges with a union-find structure using path compression and union by size; for each query, read the set size stored at the root.
